//: Hindsight alert :: latency drift. Anomaly rule on p95 hindsight.step.duration. SigNoz EE v0.133.0 supports anomaly detection (ruleType 'anomaly_rule'); if your build lacks it, change ruleType to 'threshold_rule' and set condition.op/target to a fixed p95 ceiling. Fires to 'hindsight-replay-engine' webhook channel -> http://localhost:4123/hooks/signoz. Metric name frozen in packages/shared/src/telemetry.ts (METRIC.STEP_DURATION). VALIDATE ON IMPORT: authored offline; the rules API requires auth.

annotations.summary: Latency drift: agent {{$labels.hindsight.agent.id}} p95 step duration anomalous ({{$value}})
annotations.description: p95 step duration deviated from its seasonal baseline. Often precedes a run failure; the replay-engine records it for postmortem correlation.
